permission_statement: The user confirmed mod-author permission to use and package these supplied archive assets in Ghost Studio. This record does not assert a general public license. Underlying rights remain with the respective creators and rights holders.

conversion_tools.name: cicdec
conversion_tools.purpose: Extracted the supplied Temple installer without executing it.

excluded_source_candidates.reason: Tall narrow pier/obelisk silhouette was misleading as a gate.
Planar wall card was not suitable as structural kit geometry.
Narrow slab duplicated stronger ruin and facade pieces.
Oversized preassembled composite limited intentional placement.

textures.source_substitution_reason: The supplied archive did not contain Rhn_bldg_snow_2.tga; the Ghost Studio original snow texture is used as a documented fallback for this authorized render mesh.
